doc.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing thanks and transcription credit
summary: Brown thanks her for sharing her life; she says she is honored.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I don’t know. Let’s save some time so we can do a tour of your house here and all the wonderful mementos on the wall. But before we do that, I just want to say, Annie, on behalf of the Smithsonian Institution and the National Endowment for the Arts, and Ken and myself, for you opening your door and letting us come in here, you sharing your life with us . . .
I’m honored. I’m truly honored. Thank you.
